2116545861790650594.en_summary: S&P just revised $META credit outlook to negative and this Wedbush model shows exactly why. Meta’s compute capacity is projected to nearly quadruple to 26GW by 2030 on ~$1.2T in cumulative capex pushing annual depreciation to $171B without an established $AMZN, $GOOGL or $MSFT style cloud business to monetize that capacity. But I also think that’s where opportunity gets super interesting because Muse has over 25% of its weekly active users already shopping while Meta’s Business Agents handle over 30M customer conversations a week creating an opportunity for Meta to capture a share of transactions its AI agents facilitate.
2116545861790650594.zh_summary: 標普剛剛將 $META 信用展望修訂為負面，而這個Wedbush模型準確顯示了原因。Meta的計算能力預計到2030年將幾乎四倍增至26GW，累計資本支出約1.2萬億美元，將年折舊推至1710億美元，而沒有像 $AMZN、$GOOGL 或 $MSFT 那樣的成熟雲業務來變現該能力。但我認為這正是機會變得超級有趣的地方，因為Muse已有超過25%的週活躍用戶在購物，而Meta的Business Agents每週處理超過3000萬次客戶對話，為Meta創造機會來捕獲其AI代理促進的交易份額。

ticker_notes.META: 信用展望負面，但AI代理有交易機會
